source_review.notes: Checked all eight sources for identity, authority, current status or publication date, and bounded claim scope. IFIP WG 10.4 identifies the 2004 dependability taxonomy; the official ISO record identifies ISO/IEC 25010:2023 edition 2 and its product-quality model. Google SRE sources support risk trade-offs, time/request availability, service usability, durability, and integrity/recovery distinctions. Current PostgreSQL 18 documentation supports WAL and synchronous-replication acknowledgment examples. Seven URLs returned HTTP 200; ISO's official page was retrieved successfully through browser search but returned HTTP 403 to direct curl due its access policy. Checked 2026-09-06.
